telemetry-default.rationale: The production Viewer discloses a vendor daily installation ping with random UUID, version, OS, architecture and kind. The production Viewer ping is on by default. The inspected store initializes enabled=true, while test/development/CI modes are excluded. Privacy settings persist an enabled preference; DELEGATUS_TELEMETRY=0 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 override the interface setting. The easiest documented off control is the in-app Settings Privacy switch. Environment opt-outs are also available.
